newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian stocks end touch higher in erratic trade.
newsitem.headline: Colombian stocks end touch higher in erratic trade.

text.p: Colombian stocks edged up slightly in erratic trading led by blue chips, dealers said.

Medellin's IBOMED general price index finished ahead a slight 0.1 percent at 18,404.94 on above average trading volume of 9.9 billion pesos. Bogota's IBB price index closed up 0.10 percent 1,206.88 on volume of 2 billion pesos.
Traders said the slight upward push came on expectation of strong first half results, expected later this month.
Among the day's biggest gainers were Banco de Bogota, up 0.43 percent to 6,880 in Bogota and up 0.58 percent to 6,900 in Medellin.
Banco Ganadero gained 0.24 percent to close at 407 in both Bogota and Medellin.
Brewing giant Bavaria, meanwhile, slipped back 1.21 percent to 8,150 pesos on volume of 1.2 billion pesos in Bogota and lost just one centavo to close at 8,200 in Medellin.
Dealers said lack of information about the brewer's first half performance had caused see-saw trading in Bavaria stock.
